original_response.report:
Scope: m5_matched_assessment@1.0.0 evaluates two NEW paired full-history experimental outcomes, original075 and original15, each with a complete 35-update forecast history and a matching complete experimental-controller backend reference (execution IDs 95a80128... and 5e34c916...), sharing implementation identity f322378f.... These are new experimental outcomes, not historical production results; the incumbent is unchanged, the six protected validation backend slots are untouched with no grants created, and M5 remains open.

Trajectory/aggregate accuracy: metric_accuracy is false on all three gates for both candidates. original075 terminal error matched (predicted 0.003188 m vs actual 0.003179 m, diff +8.9e-6 m) but holding was mispredicted: holding max position error actual 0.003373 m vs predicted 0.003227 m (diff -1.47e-4, actual worse) and holding max speed actual 0.022344 m/s vs predicted 0.012174 m/s (diff -1.02e-2, roughly double). original15: terminal diff -5.7e-5 m, holding position diff +1.0e-6 m, holding speed diff -4.3e-3 m/s. Trajectory samples: original075 has 2/35 position, vector and speed passes with peak position deviation 7.46e-4 m and peak speed deviation 5.42e-2 m/s; original15 has 6/35 with peaks 4.53e-4 m and 2.06e-2 m/s.

Pass/fail classification: original15 forecast and actual joint classifications agree (both true; no false-feasible or false-infeasible on any gate). original075 is a false-safe: forecast joint true, actual joint false because actual holding speed 0.022344 m/s exceeds the 0.02 m/s limit (false_feasible joint = true). Under the actual rules original075 is predicted_violating and original15 predicted_safe; accuracy_passed is false.

Feasibility-qualified ordering: predicted and actual pair decisions both resolve to [original15, original075] with original075 the hypothetical rejection, so the pairwise rank direction is correct (resolved, no abstention). Predicted gap -1.75e-3 m/s, actual gap -7.64e-3 m/s. However the forecast graded the lower-speed candidate predicted-safe, so useful is false, and safety_claim is false in both decisions — the resolved rank is a testable forecast, not a proven safe rejection.

Earliest divergences and bottleneck: for original075 the earliest output-threshold failure and command divergence both occur at update 2 (0.02 s), where full current-state Linf is ~1.3e-15 and projected Linf ~8.5e-14 (essentially identical states), while forecast selection iteration 5 differs from backend iteration 10 and command Linf is 4.75e-2 N; current-state divergence follows at update 3. For original15 divergence appears later (command/current-state at update 4, output-threshold at update 6, selection iteration 4 vs 10). Temporal order alone cannot identify a unique cause, but the pattern is consistent with the stated limitation that timed optimizer stopping can select different trajectories under identical controller code/settings. The measured computational bottleneck is optimization_solve_s (pair component total ~299.18 s of ~386 s, alongside warm preparation 83.65 s and plan validation 3.14 s).

Local numerical checks: fixed_backend_transition_validation@2.0.0 reports passed = true over 8 component evaluations and 4 local intervals with 0 controller updates and 0 backend attempts (Cholesky-vs-LU and LU-vs-new-backend differences 1e-16 to 1e-19, max scaled residual ~6.4e-13, max backward error ~5e-17, condition estimates ~2430-2491). These are post-outcome fixed-input diagnostics targeting only the registered fixed 0.5 ms map; they cannot repair a sealed failed history and are not independent backend validation or hardware evidence.

Operational economics and realtime: both backends were executed, so actual avoided evaluations and actual savings are zero (counterfactual net -198.85 s; operational_use_qualified false); the metered boundary shows no double charge and no numerical replay. Realtime is not demonstrated: deadline 0.01 s, forecast and backend each record 70/70 deadline misses, with software input-to-command median ~6.5 s and max ~14.3 s and backend controller-boundary median ~6.49 s / max ~14.37 s. The 599.76 s cold compile increment is a measured scenario increment for this exact structure only; no hardware guarantee is claimed. Full software timing remains seconds-scale and the 10 ms requirement is unchanged.

Recommendation basis: the measured evidence — false metric-accuracy on all gates, a false-safe feasibility classification on original075, correct-but-not-useful pairwise ordering, seconds-scale latency with universal deadline misses, and zero realized savings — does not support continuation/use of the current paired-forecast route.
original_response.recommendation: Stop at the explicit development checkpoint: no revision, rerun, or further same-policy paired forecast/reference work on this route. The current wall-time policy cannot provide the 10 ms guarantee and the forecast gate accuracy it depends on is currently failing (false-safe on original075, all metric-accuracy flags false, accuracy_passed false, pairwise ordering resolved/correct but not useful). Any future motion should be a separately authorized, bounded effort to develop and independently authorize a controller algorithm/termination rule whose complete measured input-to-command latency meets 10 ms, after which paired forecast/reference accuracy and feasibility tests would be repeated — with no threshold relaxation, incumbent unchanged, protected slots unspent, and M5 open.
unresolved: Whether the timed iteration-selection difference (e.g., 5 vs 10 at update 2 for original075) is the unique cause of divergence; temporal ordering cannot establish unique causality.
Whether any redesigned controller/termination can simultaneously meet the 10 ms input-to-command requirement and preserve accurate paired forecast/feasibility ordering — not demonstrated.

Whether the pairwise order and the original075 false-safe result reproduce under an untouched independent prospective pair; the six protected backend slots remain unspent and no grant was created (formal_validation_admitted false).
Generalizability of the fixed local numerical diagnostics beyond the registered fixed 0.5 ms map and beyond the sampled updates (0, 1, 30); they cannot repair the sealed failed history.
Whether the measured economic conclusion holds beyond the observed backend costs, given operational_use_qualified is false and actual savings are zero.
The 599.76 s cold compile increment is scoped to this exact structure and is not evidence of a universal compile cost.

contradictions: The first response calls original075 terminal error matched although its 8.88121998851273e-6 m discrepancy exceeds the unchanged 1e-6 m accuracy tolerance. Both candidates fail every aggregate metric gate; task-position classification can nevertheless be correct.

The first response explains useful=false by the lower-speed candidate being predicted-safe. original15 is also actually safe. The defects are the failed quantitative gates and original075 false-feasible holding-speed/joint classification, not the correct original15 classification.

The first response gives unsupported approximate residual/backward-error ranges. Use the supplied exact maxima below or omit those approximate ranges. Fixed-input agreement does not repair complete closed-loop error.
